title: AgentRequest
description: A question sent by a client app to a virtual persona. Published to agent.requests.

requestId.description: Unique id of the request. A repeated requestId is not processed twice.

conversationId.description: Chosen by the client app. Groups the questions of one conversation.

personaId.description: Virtual persona being asked (the name of its knowledge folder).

question.description: The question. Its maximum length is enforced by the agent configuration.

replyTo.description: Topic where the client app reads the replies. Its suffix identifies the client app.

sentAt.description: When the client app sent the request (UTC).

clientContext.description: Free data of the client app, returned unchanged in every reply.
